version_note: Append-only candidate. The signed v2 contract remains canonical until the owner signs these exact bytes and a later promotion step updates the canonical manifest. frozen=false is deliberate and must not be presented as Gate-2 authorization.
principle: Remove identity and assignment labels only. Never delete substantive evidence. The final diff comes from the operator-captured, live-container-verified scorer-packet v2 rather than producer prose.

required_verification: fixed artifact paths, byte counts and sha256 match
run_id, baseline_commit, output_commit and container_id match expected values
live running-container bytes match every captured artifact
final diff is baseline_commit to output_commit and covers every tracked path
offline reproduction rechecks tracked inventory against the diff, workspace inventory against captured paths, and the exact scorer core plus required attachments
source_packet.claim_boundary: The source packet and live re-read establish byte and identity linkage. They do not authenticate the operator or prove semantic correctness.

producer_output_artifact.name: in-memory raw-output value
fixed_section_order: 3. VALIDATOR_OUTPUT: uniform post-hoc validator output run identically on all four arms
producer_output_artifact.reserved_marker_rule: A source containing any standalone section marker is rejected rather than ambiguously parsed.
producer_output_artifact.attrition_policy: If any arm source contains CR or a reserved standalone marker, the complete four-arm run is NO-GO before scoring. Do not selectively exclude, repair, or rerun one arm. A later escaping or recapture rule requires a separately reviewed owner amendment and a fresh run of every arm.

canonical_builder.atomicity: All outputs are fully serialized first. Components are atomically written, the manifest is written last, and every partial final is removed on any failure.
canonical_builder.authorization_notice: Every candidate build states pending owner re-sign and is not Gate-2-authorized.

acceptable_handoff.rule: Before scorer delivery, the experimenter or owner verifier must recheck the pinned packet's semantic inventory and scorer-input invariants, then deterministically rebuild the exact packet and receipt bytes from the pinned scorer packet, test log, validator output, candidate contract, pinned redaction runner and closed blinding-compromised reason code when present. The arm-identity-blind scorer receives only the verified redacted set and the identity-free verifier result, never the identity-bearing source packet or experimenter detail.
acceptable_handoff.candidate_limit: Mechanical acceptance does not authorize Gate 2 while candidate_authorization is pending_owner_resign.

validator_output_split.treatment_time_validator_feedback: Arm D input only; experimenter provenance only; never scorer input.
validator_output_split.post_hoc_uniform_validator_output: Run identically on all four committed outputs and supplied as VALIDATOR_OUTPUT.
validator_output_split.residual_leak_rule: Flag blinding_compromised; never delete substantive evidence.

present.experimenter_detail: required non-blank UTF-8 file for build; never published, hashed, copied into the scorer packet or required by an independent verifier

blinding_compromised_input.verification: The verifier receives only the same reason code used by the builder. Omission or substitution fails deterministic reproduction; raw detail remains experimenter-side and is not a verifier input.
blinding_compromised_input.role_boundary: The experimenter may hold the identity-bearing detail file. The owner or independent reviewer verifies the identity-free candidate with the closed reason code only. Arm-identity-blind scorers receive neither the detail file nor identity-bearing source material.

common_mode_channel_effect.mechanism: All four producers use the same argv-only adapter and provide write/report bodies as base64.
common_mode_channel_effect.observed_effect: In live canary 172217 and 194819 the producer reduced solution content, including deleting a module docstring, to lower manual base64 transcription risk.
common_mode_channel_effect.preregistered_interpretation: This burden is common-mode but not evidence-neutral. Scorers see the complete operator-captured diff and may score any resulting quality loss normally. No score normalization or post-hoc adjustment is permitted.
common_mode_channel_effect.safety_decision: Do not add a plaintext shell write verb; preserving the argv-only boundary takes precedence over treatment neutrality.
common_mode_channel_effect.claim_boundary: Common-mode exposure does not prove equal behavioral impact across arms.

redaction.matching: case-insensitive regexes applied globally in listed order

anonymous_id.canonical_input: in-memory four-section UTF-8/LF bytes before redaction
anonymous_id.id_format: OUT- plus first 12 lowercase hex characters of sha256

roles.producers: four answer-blind contexts; each knows its own treatment
roles.scorers: two arm-identity-blind contexts; neither knows the A/B/C/D mapping before scoring
roles.experimenter: may know the answer; captures and verifies packets, runs uniform post-hoc validators, performs redaction, holds the mapping, and is the only role allowed to retain the raw blinding-compromised detail file
roles.owner_or_independent_reviewer: verifies the identity-free candidate using the closed reason code and does not require or receive the raw blinding-compromised detail
roles.detail_retention: the raw detail remains outside the published candidate and scorer handoff; retention and access stay experimenter-side

release_gate: Release anon-id to arm mapping only after both scorers submit scores and blinding-check guesses.
